description: Grok Replica — a study clone of a Grok-style chat app. Dark-first, minimal, fast. Chats run on the user's own free Gemini API key; nothing is faked.

design.references: grok.com (layout, black canvas, centered composer), Linear (hairline rules, restrained motion), Raycast (command-like density)
design.signature: the black page — pure black canvas, hairline 1px rules, one centered column, white text only. No cards, no gradients, no color except white.

name: grok-replica
